summary: Operator site live; 'Book Now' goes to its own Park With Us engine (25 of 50 RV sites bookable online). Confirmed fees $35 (re-sourced; monthly rates added) and hookups 50/water/sewer (derived -> manual). Added showers, Wi-Fi, 63 sites, max rig 60 ft, booking on the operator engine, 10% military discount. Note cleaned of hookup, bathhouse/laundry and rate facts. Pin is on the RV field (engine's park point ~80 m away).
flags: Gate facts (private): posted $35/night (2026 rates page, $210/week); not a Good Sam Park on its pages; nearest gateway none within 40 km (gateways.py); no trip references. Passes the $50 gate. Presence: own website with phone 478-365-3332 plus a live booking engine; Google 4.5 on 39 reviews.

Long-stay leaning: the operator pitches 'weekend getaways and extended stays' and a long-term page for 'seasonal guests, workers, and long-term travelers'; monthly $550/$600. Test 2 passes (nightly rate posted, 1-night minimum on the engine); 25 of the 50 RV sites are bookable online nightly, so test 4 passes; a site review says 'Stayed for one night passing through'. No homes/lots for sale seen. Keep.

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront', but the engine's seven 'Lake Lot' sites are tagged 'Site backs up to the lake' (Colemans Lake, an oxbow of the Ogeechee). Those lake lots are monthly-only (not bookable nightly). On imagery the main nightly RV field sits ~100 m south of the lake behind a tree belt. Suggest leaving 'not waterfront' for nightly campers, but the gate should look.
Engine lists every RV site as back-in; the home page says 'a few pull-through sites' - pull_through left unset.
Passport America 50% appears in the engine config but marked not bookable - not recorded.
